effect.name: GM Anamorphic Streak
effect.desc: Horizontal optical streaks isolated from high-luminance regions.
effect.shader: const vec3 L=vec3(0.2126,0.7152,0.0722);vec3 pnkjStreakHighlight(vec4 c){float y=dot(c.rgb,L);return c.rgb*max(y-threshold,0.0)/max(y,0.0001);} void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm;vec2 texSize=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));vec2 p=vec2(length/texSize.x,0.0);vec4 s=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);vec3 v=pnkjStreakHighlight(s)*0.20;v+=(pnkjStreakHighlight(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+p*0.25,0.0,1.0)))+pnkjStreakHighlight(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv-p*0.25,0.0,1.0))))*0.16;v+=(pnkjStreakHighlight(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+p*0.5,0.0,1.0)))+pnkjStreakHighlight(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv-p*0.5,0.0,1.0))))*0.12;v+=(pnkjStreakHighlight(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+p,0.0,1.0)))+pnkjStreakHighlight(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv-p,0.0,1.0))))*0.08;gl_FragColor=vec4(s.rgb+v*tint.rgb*strength,s.a);}
